AdBlock.Title: Adblocker
AdBlock.Subtitle: Blocks ads and trackers in every browser and app – through EZTool's own DNS server.
AdBlock.LogEmpty: No queries yet. Turn the adblocker on and open a website.
AdBlock.List.adguard: Ads and trackers, very few false positives
AdBlock.List.hagezi: Stricter, blocks more trackers – single sites may break
AdBlock.UpstreamNote: All other queries leave your PC encrypted (DNS over HTTPS).
AdBlock.RulesEmpty: No rules yet. If a website stops working, allow its domain in the live log.
AdBlock.RuleInvalid: That is not a valid domain.
AdBlock.LimitsText: Ads on YouTube and Twitch come from the same servers as the videos, so DNS can't block them – use a browser extension for those. While a VPN is connected, its DNS is used and the adblocker is bypassed. If a browser uses its own "secure DNS", turn that off in the browser.
AdBlock.Rescue: EZTool resets your DNS settings when it closes. No internet after a crash? Start EZTool again or run "EZTool.exe --restore-dns".
AdBlock.ErrorPort: Port 53 is already used by another program (for example another DNS server or a VPN), so the adblocker can't start.
AdBlock.ErrorUpstream: The DNS provider can't be reached. Check your internet connection or pick another provider.
AdBlock.ErrorLists: The blocklists couldn't be downloaded. Check your internet connection.
AdBlock.NeedsAdmin: The adblocker needs administrator rights to switch the DNS settings. Start EZTool as administrator.
